IMPERIAL AI HACK · 15 NOV 2026 · FURKAN BORAN
One loud idea per screen. Ink borders, hard shadows, and colour only where it carries meaning.
Headlines and quotes. Italic for the turn of the sentence.
Code, paths, labels and stickers. Uppercase, tracked out.
Sticker: one per fact. Lime means verified, coral means look closer.
Card: 2.5px ink border, 5px hard shadow, 18px radius. Button: pill, butter, 6px shadow. Citation: lavender, serif italic.

# newer FastAPI validates an explicit JSON null against the type
An explicit JSON null for a field with a default is no longer replaced by the default.
It is validated against the type and rejected with a 422. Found by testing the docstring’s intent in the sandbox.
“Clients that used null to request a default should omit the value instead.”
fastapi.tiangolo.com/release-notes · quote verified word for word
Pins the documented behaviour: tablets send null for “not filled in”, and that must mean one unit.
fix: Claude Opus 5.5 · verify: Claude Sonnet 5.5 + Linkup · store: Databricks

Lines with width 0 are no longer drawn, so the hairline grid disappeared.
Observed in the sandbox. Cutoff searched the release notes and found no entry it could quote.
